metric_definitions.scheduledCount: Total scheduled sample epochs over 108 scenarios (75,600 total).
metric_definitions.s0NormalStateOccupancyPercent: FSM tracking state occupancy: s0NormalCount / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.measurementValidatedTrustedPercent: Strict measurement-validated tracking: (s0NormalCount with decision != rejected) / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.s0PredictOnlyPercent: Samples in S0 running on inertial prediction without measurement admittance: (s0NormalCount with decision == rejected) / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.positionOutputAvailabilityPercent: Fixes where valid position estimate is produced: (S0 + S0_prov + S1 + S5) / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.directCommittedDistancePercent: Fixes where distance increments are committed directly: s0NormalCount / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.measurementAnchoredDistancePercent: Fixes where distance increments are committed from an admitted measurement: (s0NormalCount with decision != rejected) / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.measurementAcceptanceRatePercent: Ratio of raw non-rejected measurements: acceptedMeasurementCount / scheduledCount.
metric_definitions.gapDeltaPercent: Difference between legacy availability and S0 state occupancy: legacyAvailabilityPercent - s0NormalStateOccupancyPercent.
metric_definitions.measurementValidationGapDeltaPercent: Difference between legacy availability and measurement-validated availability: legacyAvailabilityPercent - measurementValidatedTrustedPercent.
metric_definitions.recoveryLatencyP95: 95th percentile duration (seconds) from entry to S2 until reaching S0 Normal Tracking.
metric_definitions.unresolvedEventCount: Loss-of-lock events that did not fully recover to S0 before the scenario terminated.
